podcast.title: Marfan Syndrome and Family History
podcast.body: Austin Carlile, the former lead singer of Of Mice and Men, has Marfan Syndrome, a genetic disorder impacting connective tissue throughout the body. His mother tragically died from the same condition, highlighting the severe implications it can have. "Carlyle's mum actually died from the condition."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
